INSERT INTO candles (instrument_id, timeframe, start, "end", open, high, low, close, complete, revision, received_at, observed_at, volume, volume_complete, volume_received_at, volume_revision) VALUES ($1::VARCHAR, $2::VARCHAR, $3::BIGINT, $4::BIGINT, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10::INTEGER, $11::BIGINT, $12::BIGINT, $13, $14, $15::BIGINT, $16::INTEGER) ON CONFLICT (instrument_id, timeframe, start) DO UPDATE SET "end" = excluded."end", open = excluded.open, high = excluded.high, low = excluded.low, close = excluded.close, complete = excluded.complete, revision = CASE WHEN (candles."end" IS DISTINCT FROM excluded."end" OR candles.open IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.open OR candles.high IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.high OR candles.low IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.low OR candles.close IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.close OR candles.complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.complete) THEN candles.revision + $17::INTEGER ELSE candles.revision END, received_at = CASE WHEN (candles."end" IS DISTINCT FROM excluded."end" OR candles.open IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.open OR candles.high IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.high OR candles.low IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.low OR candles.close IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.close OR candles.complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.complete) THEN $18::BIGINT ELSE candles.received_at END, observed_at = excluded.observed_at, volume = excluded.volume, volume_complete = excluded.volume_complete, volume_received_at = CASE WHEN (excluded.volume_received_at > candles.volume_received_at) THEN excluded.volume_received_at ELSE candles.volume_received_at END, volume_revision = CASE WHEN (candles.volume IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.volume OR candles.volume_complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.volume_complete) THEN candles.volume_revision + $19::INTEGER ELSE candles.volume_revision END WHERE candles."end" IS DISTINCT FROM excluded."end" OR candles.open IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.open OR candles.high IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.high OR candles.low IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.low OR candles.close IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.close OR candles.complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.complete OR candles.volume IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.volume OR candles.volume_complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.volume_complete OR excluded.observed_at > candles.observed_at OR excluded.volume_received_at > candles.volume_received_at RETURNING candles.id
